parts.name: TableRoot
parts.description: A Glaze part with no Bisque equivalent: the `<table>`, inside a frame that scrolls sideways when the table is wider than its place. Write plain `<thead>`, `<tbody>` and `<tr>` inside it; they are styled by their elements. It takes the native table attributes.

props.name: layout
props.description: How columns get their widths. `auto`: from their content. `fixed`: each column is the size the table holds for it, which resizing needs; the table is then as wide as its columns and the frame scrolls.

dataAttributes.name: data-layout
dataAttributes.description: `auto` or `fixed`, as the `layout` prop.

parts.name: TableColumnHeader
parts.description: A column's header cell, a `<th>`. It carries `aria-sort` while its column is sorted, spans the columns a group header stands over, and holds the column's size and pinned offset as custom properties.

props.name: header
props.description: The header this cell is for: one of `group.headers` from `table.getHeaderGroups()`, or of `table.getFlatHeaders()`.

dataAttributes.name: data-column
dataAttributes.description: The column's id.

dataAttributes.name: data-pinned
dataAttributes.description: `start` or `end` while the column is pinned.

dataAttributes.name: data-placeholder
dataAttributes.description: Present on a header that only fills the space above a column in a deeper header group.

dataAttributes.name: data-resizing
dataAttributes.description: Present while the column is being resized.

dataAttributes.name: data-sorted
dataAttributes.description: `asc` or `desc` while the column is sorted.

cssVariables.name: --column-start
cssVariables.description: On a column pinned to the start: its distance from the table's start edge.

cssVariables.name: --column-end
cssVariables.description: On a column pinned to the end: its distance from the table's end edge.

parts.name: TableSortTrigger
parts.description: A button that sorts by its column: ascending, descending, then unsorted, in the order the column's options give. With Shift held it adds the column to the sort. Disabled for a column that can't be sorted. Put it in the column's header cell.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the column can't be sorted.

dataAttributes.name: data-sort-index
dataAttributes.description: Where the column stands among the sorted columns, from 0.

dataAttributes.name: data-sorted
dataAttributes.description: `asc` or `desc` while the column is sorted.

parts.name: TableColumnResizer
parts.description: A handle that resizes its column by dragging. It is a focusable `separator` whose value is the column's size: the arrow keys resize it, Home and End go to its smallest and largest size, and a double click puts the size back. Give it an `aria-label` that names the column.

props.name: header
props.description: The header whose column the handle resizes.

props.name: step
props.description: Pixels an arrow key changes the size by.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the column can't be resized.

dataAttributes.name: data-resizing
dataAttributes.description: Present while the column is being resized.

parts.name: TableRow
parts.description: A body row, a `<tr>`, with its state as `data-*` attributes to style by.

dataAttributes.name: data-depth
dataAttributes.description: How deep the row is in a tree or under group rows, from 0.

dataAttributes.name: data-expanded
dataAttributes.description: Present while the row is expanded.

dataAttributes.name: data-grouped
dataAttributes.description: Present on a group's own row.

dataAttributes.name: data-pinned
dataAttributes.description: `top` or `bottom` while the row is pinned.

dataAttributes.name: data-row
dataAttributes.description: The row's id.

dataAttributes.name: data-selected
dataAttributes.description: Present while the row is selected.

parts.name: TableCell
parts.description: A body cell, a `<td>`, with its column's size and pinned offset as custom properties.

dataAttributes.name: data-aggregated
dataAttributes.description: In a group's row: present on a cell that holds the group's aggregate.

dataAttributes.name: data-column
dataAttributes.description: The column's id.

dataAttributes.name: data-grouped
dataAttributes.description: In a group's row: present on the cell that names the group.

dataAttributes.name: data-pinned
dataAttributes.description: `start` or `end` while the column is pinned.

dataAttributes.name: data-placeholder
dataAttributes.description: Under a group: present on the grouped column's cell, which stays empty.

cssVariables.name: --column-start
cssVariables.description: On a column pinned to the start: its distance from the table's start edge.

cssVariables.name: --column-end
cssVariables.description: On a column pinned to the end: its distance from the table's end edge.

parts.name: TableSelectRow
parts.description: A checkbox that selects its row: a CheckboxRoot wired to the table. Shift with a press selects every row from the last one pressed to this one. It is mixed while only some of the row's sub-rows are selected, and disabled for a row that can't be selected. Labelled "Select row": pass an `aria-label` that names the row.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the row can't be selected.

parts.name: TableSelectAll
parts.description: A checkbox that selects every row, or every row on the current page: checked when all are selected, mixed when some are. A CheckboxRoot wired to the table, labelled "Select all rows".

props.name: scope
props.description: Which rows the box stands for: `all`, or the rows on the current `page`.

parts.name: TableExpandTrigger
parts.description: A button that shows and hides what is under its row: sub-rows, a group's rows, or a detail row the app renders while `row.getIsExpanded()`. It carries `aria-expanded`, and is disabled for a row with nothing under it.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the row has nothing to show.

dataAttributes.name: data-expanded
dataAttributes.description: Present while the row is expanded.

parts.name: TableColumnFilter
parts.description: A text input that filters by its column: rows are kept while the column's value matches what is typed, as the column's `filterFn` decides. Empty means no filter. Disabled for a column that can't be filtered.

dataAttributes.name: data-filtered
dataAttributes.description: Present while the column has a filter.

parts.name: TableGlobalFilter
parts.description: A search input over every column that allows it: rows are kept while any of those columns matches. Empty means no filter.

dataAttributes.name: data-filtered
dataAttributes.description: Present while there is a search.

parts.name: TableColumnToggle
parts.description: A checkbox that shows and hides its column: a CheckboxRoot wired to the table. Disabled for a column that can't be hidden. Label it with the column's name.

props.name: column
props.description: The column to show and hide.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the column can't be hidden.

parts.name: TablePagination
parts.description: A PaginationRoot whose page is the table's. Put Pagination's own parts inside it, and read `use pagination` for the page numbers.

props.name: siblingCount
props.description: Pages shown on each side of the current one.

props.name: boundaryCount
props.description: Pages always shown at the start and at the end.
